en.text:
Passively grants 40 Airborne Effectiveness, 50 Handling, and a 0.8x Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier to Submachine Guns (SMGs).

Grants the following while holding an SMG:
• 30 Mobility
• 6.25% increased Sprint Speed
• 33% increased Slide Distance
• 33% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty (25%⁠🠚⁠16.75%)

<title Refills [G_refill] /> the Magazine of SMGs 1 second after they are stowed, even if the SMG is re-equipped within this window.

Scoring SMG Hits on PVE Combatants grants a Stack of 'Damage Buff' for 1 second. Maximum of 20 stacks. Damage Buff grants 5% increased SMG damage per stack, capping out at 100%.

Boss-Tier Enemies take 33% decreased damage from Peacekeeper-buffed shots.
